selection.toad_scale_target: body approximately 5–7% of 1536px canvas width; small observer, not human-sized

shared_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: revised Sichuan countryside story postcard for “旅行癞疙宝”.
The supplied image is the EDIT TARGET and style/identity reference, NOT a scale reference. Preserve its original toad design, indigo flower bag, human painting style, color family, location atmosphere and gentle hand-painted look. The USER REJECTED the toad's oversized proportion: correct the physical scale and recompose to a wider environmental view. Do NOT preserve the giant foreground toad, do NOT just move that same giant body slightly.
SCALE IS THE TOP PRIORITY: one SMALL low toad, body width roughly 80–105 pixels in a 1536-wide image (about 5–7% of total canvas width), body height about 55–75 pixels. Toad plus its appropriately reduced small satchel should fit within roughly 135 pixels total width. Preserve recognition at this small size through silhouette, amber eyes, cream belly and blue bag, not an enlarged face. It must be much smaller than a seated adult's torso and below human knee height if on the same ground plane, and smaller than the width of a stool seat. It is a small animal observer, NOT a human-sized mascot. Do not place it in extreme foreground where perspective makes it huge. Show clear ground contact, credible perspective, open space and natural separation from the human activity.
CHARACTER LOCK: broad squat olive toad, head/body fused with no neck, short rounded forelimbs and folded hind legs, half-lidded amber-gold eyes, bean-shaped orange parotoid glands, cream belly, a few larger familiar olive markings. Same indigo cloth bag with white flower, brass clasp and tiny red chili knot, scaled consistently with the now small toad. Only one toad and one bag; no clothes, human ears, anthropomorphic height, oversized head floating in scenery or duplicate character.
STYLE: match warm gentle storybook gouache / watercolor with deep-brown hand contours, olive/moss green, cream sunlit planes, honey bamboo and gray tiles. Low-speckle broad connected color shapes: leaves base green plus one large shadow, distant tree masses and rice clumps grouped, smooth large earth/paving color planes with a few soft shifts and necessary joints, restrained directional wood/bamboo marks. No noisy mottling, dotted highlights or added gritty paper overlay. Preserve crisp structure and softly modeled volume; not blurred, bleached, flat vector, 3D or photographic.
OUTPUT: one opaque full-bleed 1536×1024 landscape 3:2 illustration. No postcard border, captions, UI, signatures, logos or watermarks. Scene decoration text only if explicitly specified in the scene brief below. No other story changes beyond this requested revision.

entries.title: 看人采耳，自己也眯了眼
entries.story: 师傅拿着细家伙什，在茶客耳边轻轻忙活。它隔着竹椅看了半晌，见人家眯着眼，自己也跟着眯了眯。
entries.scene:
SCENE CHANGE: The story is now “the small toad sees OTHER PEOPLE receiving ear cleaning” (看见别人在采耳). Replace the oversized toad ON the bamboo recliner with an ordinary ADULT HUMAN TEA CUSTOMER. The middle-aged / older male customer reclines naturally in the bamboo chair, fully dressed in a plain light cream-gray shirt, dark loose trousers and everyday shoes, eyes comfortably closed. The original adult practitioner in a rolled-sleeve blue-gray shirt stands or sits beside the customer's head. He gently works at the customer's HUMAN EAR with a slim fine soft-tipped ear-cleaning tool, ordinary calm posture, both people anatomically coherent. A folded cloth and compact tool roll nearby; normal village teahouse service, no medical procedure diagram, blood, wax closeup, deep insertion or distress.
Move the toad completely OFF the chair to a quiet edge of the courtyard path a few steps away, in the side middle-ground, watching the TWO HUMANS. Tiny body dimensions as the scale rule: about 90px wide in the 1536px-wide picture. Toad looks toward the ear-cleaning pair; it does NOT receive treatment, does not sit on someone's lap or furniture, and no human reaches toward it. Put its small blue bag immediately beside it on the ground, not a human-sized bag left on the previous stool. Leave a visible stretch of paving between it and the service.
Wider eye-level environmental view of the same leafy outdoor Chengdu tea courtyard: old shade tree, cream umbrella, gray-tiled white wall, bamboo tea tables and empty chairs, one lidded blue-white tea bowl on the nearby table. The two HUMAN figures and bamboo chair are the main story focus, the small toad an unobtrusive observer discovered on the side. Keep both humans fully inside the frame with readable interaction and normal scale; foreground can be paving / low plant frame, never a giant toad. No fans, extra toads, prominent written signs or lettering.

entries.title: 隔着田埂，看场寿宴
entries.story: 院坝里摆开了一桌又一桌，寿桃端到了老人家面前。它远远停在田埂边，看大家笑着敬寿：今天这儿，闹热得很。
entries.scene:
SCENE CHANGE: A larger Sichuan village outdoor BIRTHDAY / LONGEVITY BANQUET (祝寿坝坝宴), the user-authorized chosen occasion. Widen the courtyard and move the camera back to show the full gathering, slightly elevated three-quarter establishing view rather than the old close-toad composition.
The toad is MUCH SMALLER and farther from the feast: about 80–95 pixels body width on a 1536-pixel canvas. Put it along a mid-distance paddy path OUTSIDE the courtyard, several meters away across the visible irrigation ditch / open approach, standing low on its four little feet and turning its head toward the celebration. It and its small indigo satchel are a tiny quiet side detail, not in the extreme bottom foreground and not a foreground portrait. The nearest human torso is several times bigger than the toad. Let foreground earth path, rice leaves and water establish distance.
BANQUET: clearly show EIGHT round wooden shared-meal tables rather than the former two or three, distributed across an ample DRY farmhouse courtyard in three staggered depth rows (3,3,2), with separations / serving aisles so individual tabletop silhouettes read as eight tables. At least six tables have clearly visible table surfaces, remaining two can be partly occluded naturally. Shared food platters, simple rice bowls, chopsticks, low mismatched wooden stools. Around two dozen ordinary adult / older villagers, simplified but coherent with naturally separated bodies and hands, comfortable lively conversation. One or two people carry platters through an open aisle. Side cooking setup with pot and bamboo steamers, quiet steam; do not make the crowd an indistinct texture.
BIRTHDAY THEME: at the farther central family table, one white-haired elder in a modest muted brick-red everyday jacket is the honoree; relatives smile toward the elder and offer a plate of pink-tipped peach-shaped longevity buns (寿桃). On the farmhouse wall just behind the elder, ONE modest square vermilion paper decoration bears exactly the single Chinese character “寿”, correctly formed and clearly legible, warm cream/gold simple brushwork. This small diegetic birthday decoration is the ONLY text allowed, not a title or overlay. A pair of modest red lanterns may flank this small part of the wall; do not cover the courtyard in red decorations. No age number, wedding couple, double-happiness symbol, examination celebration, giant stage, red carpet, formal tourist costumes, banners with extra words, luxury restaurant or western cake.
Keep the flat Chengdu-plain landscape identity: green rice fields, irrigation water, bamboo/tree linpan, gray-tiled white-wall farmhouse, low flat horizon and soft blue sky. Tables on dry earth courtyard, never in the flooded rice. Preserve warm sunlight and calm game style even though the occasion is convivial. Broad clean soil / foliage shapes, readable architecture and perspective, controlled details instead of dense speckling.
